## 135:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Who-stand in-house-of YHWH, in-courts-of house-of our-God.
- **LOGOS:** who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God!
- **PNEUMA:** you who serve in the LORD's house, in the courtyards of our God's temple!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
